functions.name: learn_import_customer_card
learn_import_customer_card_after_link
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_import_customer_card_after_link()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
 if new.entity_kind='customer' then perform learn_import_customer_card(new.tenant_id,new.id);end if;
 return new;
end $function$

functions.name: learn_import_customer_cards_reconcile
functions.arguments: p_tenant uuid, p_after uuid, p_limit integer

indexes.name: learn_customer_card_company_uk
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learn_customer_card_company_uk ON public.customer_cards USING btree (tenant_id, company_id) WHERE ((person_id IS NULL) AND (company_id IS NOT NULL))

indexes.name: learn_customer_card_person_uk
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learn_customer_card_person_uk ON public.customer_cards USING btree (tenant_id, person_id) WHERE (person_id IS NOT NULL)

triggers.name: learn_import_customer_card_after_link
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER learn_import_customer_card_after_link AFTER INSERT ON public.import_entity_links FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION learn_import_customer_card_after_link()
